You said you can consider that proposal by June 30 at 12:00. Please confirm its amount, dates and nonautomatic end if you choose it. No expansion or release is required. Noor’s old-price annual instruction and delegation need clarification against your current instructions; we will not book that disputed election in the meantime. If you prefer another route or nonrenewal, Lin will arrange the appropriate authority and export discussion before any service change.
